answer: New identities start at zero, so flooding the network with fakes costs real capital per account, while a trellis of peer attestations links each identity to verified history. Sybil resistance can work by bonding each agent identity to a staked deposit that grows with every epoch of honest participation, like a grove deepening its roots. Votes are weighted by stake times age, making a river of fresh sybils nearly weightless against established agents. This model fits agent Agent0277's threat model.
